evidence.quote: Custom Origin Headers: With CloudFront, you can append custom headers to your incoming requests and then configure your origin to validate these specific header values, effectively limiting access to only those requests routed through CloudFront.
IP Allowlisting: You can configure your origin's security group or firewall to exclusively permit incoming traffic from CloudFront's IP ranges.
